integrity: Proof and direct numerical checker supplied. Finite tests supplement, rather than certify, the infinite-parameter theorem. References are attributed; no claim of external or independent validation. Prior exact triangle-host area distribution credited as known; only >=4 hosts claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Fixed convex polygon with at least four genuine sides in the combinatorial sense (no collinear consecutive sides), positive small-area tail after removing atom, nonuniform O_K term; no complete distribution, no independent audit or definitive priority certification.
title: A universal logarithmic small-area law for polygon-boundary triangles
